description: EIA weekly residential heating oil or propane prices per gallon for the US or a surveyed state between two dates (series since 1990 for most areas), with high, low and average. Default is the last 52 weeks.

end_date.description: End date, default the latest week as YYYY-MM-DD.

state.description: State name or code ("Maine", "CT"), an EIA region ("New England (PADD 1A)") or "US". Default US.

name: get_heating_fuel_price_history
title: Get heating fuel price history
